task: Audit unit/E2E test completeness; migrate the repo to pnpm and build a proper GitHub Actions CI; establish a standard Next.js ESLint config and wire it into CI.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm is the package manager: packageManager and engines pinned, pnpm-lock.yaml replaces package-lock.json with resolved-version parity, and no npm invocation remains in playwright.config.ts or README.md
ESLint standard catches real defects: a type-aware config plus import/order, jsx-a11y, playwright and vitest layers, with pnpm lint --max-warnings 0 exiting 0 and zero rules disabled to reach it
Prettier is enforced and the reformat is whitespace-only, with pnpm format:check exiting 0 and machine-generated trees excluded
The named test gaps are closed: the /auth/callback error branches, a real logout click, and the Supabase-outage fail-open vs fail-closed asymmetry each have an executable test
Coverage tooling reports an honest number scoped to what it actually measures
GitHub Actions CI exists with a quality job and an e2e job, running the CI-safe Playwright subset with zero silent skips when CI is set
The CI workflow states plainly, in the file, that the authenticated path is not covered
blastRadius: Repository toolchain and CI only. No application route, screen, guard, permission or data flow was modified; the 17-file Prettier pass was verified whitespace-only.
contracts: package.json scripts consumed by CI and by contributors
pnpm-lock.yaml resolved-version parity against the deleted package-lock.json
